gaps: Every breath-one expiry was written with the clock outside the holder: a decree, a docket, a parent instrument, a development, a witness, a forum's pace, a ratifier's term, a transfer, a planning cycle, a coordination's decay, and the last intervention was a filing or an act made in time. Pressing on Slot flown empty showed a clock that runs only while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, so the keeping is the exercise; pressing on the seed's Standstill with a term showed a pause the holder asked for that gave the situation the only clock the holder wrote and handed its renewal to the adversary. This produced the changed question for breath two: which of these clocks does the holder start, and does keeping an option ever run a clock the option did not have.
accepted: Weekend closure: the option is closed by an authority whose closure works only if it is not announced, since the announcement would be the signal to exercise, so the exit is shut in the hours the holder cannot act, as the Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday decree, the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 that was extended until the deposit levy was law, the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001, and the export-licence suspension or the delisting published after the fact; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to move what is yours; the carrier is the authority's calendar aligned to the hours the holder is shut out, the Friday night and the bank holiday; the last intervention that could have kept it is a transfer made on rumour, at the price of being wrong and of the discount the rumour market charges, since the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better; so this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, and a holder who waits for a date is waiting for a thing the mechanism forbids; not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed is not one that must be a surprise, and not a rival's foreclosure, which decides about this holder, since the decree decides about the reserve and the holder's exit dies as a side effect.

Bar date in the newspaper: the claim expires on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder is not attending and is deemed to have read, as the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication, the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising, and the probate creditor's window after the notice runs in the county paper; the condition lost is a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own; the carrier is the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name; the last intervention that could have kept it is a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, since the holder who would make it is by construction the one who was not told; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date the holder can read on the stamp, the date that is written on someone else's docket and imputed to the holder; not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Emergency over: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it expires when the parent does, whatever its own merits and with no date printed on it, as the emergency-use authorization that ends with the public-health declaration, the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it did read carried no date; the last intervention that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands, and the conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it; not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest, and not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven: the option expires by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in another hand, as amblyopia, which is largely correctable by patching the good eye before about seven and largely not after, the clubfoot cast in infancy, the second language spoken without an accent, which is contested as a hard window, the duckling that imprints in its first day; the condition lost is a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire; the carrier is the developmental timetable, and the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save; the last intervention that could have kept it is a screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child; adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case where the option's holder cannot be its own witness at all; not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well: the option is dated by the last witness to the fact rather than by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it, as the stroke patient who wakes with the deficit and is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke lost the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the same rule dates the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap, which are treated as expired at the earliest time they could have been; the condition lost is a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids; the carrier is the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue; the last intervention that could have kept it is a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset; adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it; not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run, since here the body's clock may not have run and the record's has.

Mooted: the option to a decision expires because the situation resolves itself faster than the forum that would decide it moves, so nobody declines and nobody rules, as the student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974), the pregnancy over before the appeal, the election held before the ballot-access case, the tenant evicted before the housing court sits, the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post; the condition lost is a permission, the justiciability of the claim; the carrier is the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number no party at the table sets; the last intervention that could have kept it is a structure that outlives the individual harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which is what Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which is what Roe rested on, so the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying; not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve, since here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date anywhere.

Session ends: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no, as the bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that is dissolved, the permit application before a council that is re-elected, the board approval that lapses when the board is reconstituted at the meeting, the offer approved by a committee that is disbanded in the reorganization; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor body starts it at zero; the condition lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; the carrier is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term; the last intervention that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, and the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no; adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote; not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see, as the renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises, the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves, the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen, the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive; the condition lost is a counterparty, the one whose word held the option; the carrier is the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it; the last intervention that could have kept it is recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, which costs the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement; adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case, where the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over: the option to return rests on a vacancy that the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it expires at the counterparty's next planning cycle without anyone declining the return, as the leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization, the budget line reallocated at year end, the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed, the co-founder's seat that the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire; what expires is the return to the seat, since employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside; the condition lost is a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder; the carrier is the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without reference to the holder at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns; adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents, the case in which no one opposes the return and the absence is simply absorbed; not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way, since this road has closed.

Petition that goes stale: an option that requires many simultaneous yeses expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life, as the recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days, the syndicate's pro-rata rights that lapse if not exercised with the round, the tender offer's minimum condition, the crowd in the square that goes home, the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time; the condition lost is a coordination; the carrier is the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention; the last intervention that could have kept it is a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives; the recall and pro-rata cases are observed and the crowd is analogy; adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by others' leaving; not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.

Pour the foundation: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change, and it can be kept only by an act in the world that no paper substitutes for, as the building that may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passes, the footings poured the week of the council vote, the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if it is in use on the effective date, the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week; the last intervention that could have kept it is the hole in the ground before the vote, which is an exercise begun rather than a filing made, so the option can be preserved only by starting to use it; adds to first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for reasons of its own; not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right, since here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose, as the airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived, the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them, the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use, the mining claim kept by annual labour, the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the regulator's usage ledger; the last intervention that could have kept it is the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price; adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule; not Pour the foundation, one act that vests, since here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Standstill with a term: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder, as the tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again, the leave of absence that dates a job which had no date, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute, the furlough whose recall rights run six months, the temporary restraining order's fourteen days, the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state; the carrier is the pause's own instrument, and its clock is the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote; the last intervention that could have kept it is the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted, since the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary; adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.

residue.item: Age limit: the enlistment, adoption, or airline-pilot age past which the application cannot be made.
residue.why: Rejected: runway-illusions' Stamp's clock carries the permission with a date no cash extends, and the birthday is that date read from the holder's own certificate; the only addition, that the holder may not know the rule, is carried better by Bar date in the newspaper and Emergency over, where the date is on a paper the holder never held.

residue.item: Launch window: the Mars departure every twenty-six months, the transfer window, the hiring season.
residue.why: Rejected: lead-time-floors' Once a year holds the market that opens on a period; missing the window is a lead time and not an expiry, since the option returns.

residue.item: Exploding offer: the term sheet that lapses on Friday.
residue.why: Rejected and kept as the boundary case: a party at the table decided about this option and the holder can test it by letting it pass; carried by impasse-inventions' exploding intermediate and investor-tells' Fuse length and Let it lapse.

residue.item: Escheat: the dormant account taken by the state after five years without a transaction.
residue.why: Merged into Slot flown empty as a case of disuse forfeiture where the exercise that keeps it is a single login; no distinct mechanism, only a cheaper exercise.

residue.item: Witness dies: the oral agreement that cannot be proved once the only other party is dead.
residue.why: Held: witness-architectures' territory; admitted only as the record side of Last known well, where the option dies for want of proof while the fact would still allow it, since the dead witness adds no carrier that the protocol's timestamp rule does not already show.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real raise, leave, litigation, or migration runs several of these clocks at once, often one behind another, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of what the clock is made of, not a ranking of speed, fairness, or cost; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the incompatibility, loop, passages, and fork they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (the Greek and Cypriot bank closures, the 2020 slot waiver, the WAKE-UP trial, DeFunis and Sosna, Michigan's sixty-day signature rule, vested-rights doctrine, ECMO duration limits, the family-leave statute) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; doctrine varies by jurisdiction and practice by centre, and nothing here is legal or clinical advice.

Options that become unattractive rather than unexercisable are out: the down round, the mine that can be dewatered at a price, the offer that got worse; and expiries in which a party decided about this holder's option, the offer withdrawn, the exploding sheet, the rival's lock-up on every supplier, are carried by impasse-inventions, investor-tells, first-mover-forecloses, and walkaway-manufactures' Absent owner's clock. Weekend closure is in because the decree decides about the reserve and the holder's exit dies as a side effect, which is also why it cannot be probed.

Neighbouring maps in this fleet: undo-costs bills a reversal that remains possible, where Rollback horizon holds the moment it stops being possible; learning-that-commits holds the inquiry that changes the choice set, where First or never holds a move on a neighbouring matter that forfeits an option by a rule of order; advantages-spent-by-use holds an advantage consumed by exercising it, where Slot flown empty holds a permission kept only by exercising it and Outgrown the buyer a buyer lost by growing, not by using.

gaps: The changed question yielded clocks that the holder's own care for the option starts: growth that walks the buyer out of range (Outgrown the buyer), readiness that spoils the good (Thawed to be ready), a move on a neighbouring matter that forfeits by a rule of order (First or never), the new state's first ordinary act that closes the way back (Rollback horizon), and the machine that harms what it holds open (Kept on the machine), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed preserving an option was free of clocks. The territory pointer stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now walks from clocks the holder never started to clocks the holder's care started. The seriation's axis came from this: Pour the foundation is the hinge where the holder first starts a clock on purpose, Slot flown empty and Thawed to be ready are the mirrored pair at the centre, and the walk ends at the pause paper, which is the seed the brief protected.
accepted: Outgrown the buyer: the holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach, so the option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all, a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining, as the company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done, the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two, the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed; the condition lost is a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option; the carrier is the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises; the last intervention that could have kept it is the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, which is the one choice a founder is never advised to make; analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so the item stands as a mechanism and not a count; adds to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside, the market for the holder that the holder thins by growing; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans, since here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.

Thawed to be ready: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, as the vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured, the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing, the drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent brought to room temperature, the opened surgical field, the mobilized reserve whose readiness the treasury pays for by the day; the condition lost is a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state; the carrier is a chemistry or a payroll that begins at preparation; the last intervention that could have kept it is not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings, so the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing; the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched, since here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed, and not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder, since here it falls on the good.

First or never: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date, and a holder who does nothing keeps it while a holder who does anything adjacent loses it, as the objection to the court's jurisdiction that is waived if left out of the first response, the patent that is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the appeal waived by accepting the settlement, the election of remedies, the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used, the 'speak now' at the wedding; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written in a different place than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss; the last intervention that could have kept it is the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each of which costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists; not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.

Rollback horizon: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence and it closes without anyone deciding to close it, as the migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects, the merger reversible until the first combined payroll, the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives there, the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart, the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit; the condition lost is a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here; the carrier is the first write, which is performed by the new state in the ordinary course and is not a decision about the reversal at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth; adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap, the moment at which one of them is lost, and to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible, the reversal that stops being possible; not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's, as the patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed, the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening, the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end, the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider; the condition lost is a capability, the eligibility or the workings; the carrier is the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill; the last intervention that could have kept it is a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each of which treats the bridge's start as the option's deadline; the ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified; adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open; not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs, since here the clock is a harm nobody signs.

residue.item: Overwritten by rotation: the backup that rolls over and the deleted account's thirty days.
residue.why: Merged into Rollback horizon's family as its scheduled form, which is runway-illusions' Stamp's clock with a cron job for an issuer; the event-shaped version, the first write that the old state cannot read, was the one the first framing could not hold and the one admitted.

residue.item: Pumps stop: the mothballed mine that floods when dewatering ends.
residue.why: Merged into Kept on the machine as its lapse-is-one-way case, beside the ECMO circuit's harm-accumulates case; one item, since in both the preserver's clock replaces the situation's and the last intervention treats the bridge's start as the deadline.

residue.item: Fork nobody announced: the conference talk that kills the patent, the settlement that waives the appeal.
residue.why: Merged with the waived defence into First or never, since both are one rule, this before anything else or never, and the difference between a neighbouring matter and the same matter was incidental; the merged item is stronger than either half.

residue.item: Read off the crowd: an expiry legible only from the rate at which others leave, as the queue that shortens before the border shuts, the deposits that thin before the bank holiday.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: it would sit between Weekend closure and Petition that goes stale, an expiry the holder can date only by others' exits, which clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Queue clock reads the other way and which the reading empties; it needs a case with a carrier of its own, since every instance found so far was Weekend closure seen from the pavement.

neighbors.separating_case: Two firms halt the same kind of project. One signs a twelve-month tolling agreement with its adversary; the other mothballs the plant and keeps the pumps running. Let both wait two years. The first firm's clock is a date the adversary signs, each renewal costs a concession, the adversary can end it by declining to sign, and the firm learns the day it happens. The second firm's clock is water: no date is written, no counterparty can extend it, money extends it only while the pumps still run, and the day they stop a clock starts that nobody can sign. A holder who confuses them asks the adversary for time when it should be paying the pump bill, or pays the pump bill for years when one signature would have done, and the tell is whether the deadline has a signature on it.

checks.boundary_case: The exploding term sheet, the counterparty's own deadline on its own offer, is the tempting nonmember and is out: a party at the table decided about this option, the holder can probe it by letting it pass, which investor-tells' Let it lapse describes, and the urgency it makes is impasse-inventions' exploding intermediate. The fence is that an expiry decided by a party about this option is a withdrawal or a foreclosure and belongs to the leverage maps, while an expiry that falls out of a rule, a calendar, a transfer, a decay, or the holder's own unrelated act, with nobody's decision on the option, is in. Weekend closure sits on the fence and is in, since the decree decides about the reserve and the holder's exit dies as a side effect, and the same fence keeps it unprobeable. The second tempting nonmember is the option that has become merely unattractive, the mine that can be dewatered at a price, the round that got worse, and it is out by the declared type; Kept on the machine is in only where the workings collapse and the candidacy is withdrawn.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a conditional incompatibility the walk conceals: Slot flown empty and Thawed to be ready sit side by side as the two clocks the holder's own hand controls, and the edge says that where the thing drawn to keep the permission spoils once drawn, the two clocks meet and the holder must choose which expiry to take, while where it does not spoil they never meet. It shows a loop, Standstill with a term → Chair grown over → Standstill with a term, in which a pause renewed past the counterparty's planning cycle preserves a right to a chair that has grown over, and the absence of the chair makes the renewal the only thing left to ask for, so the pause renews itself past the point of preserving anything unless a return was dated inside the first cycle. It shows a passage between levels at Petition that goes stale → Session ends, where a coordination kept alive among signers expires at the level of the body that must count them, so a coordination's half-life is bounded by its ratifier's calendar. It shows a second passage at Rollback horizon → Kept on the machine, where moving the horizon by running two systems trades a clock made of events for a clock made of harm. And it shows a fork from Pour the foundation, whose two edges reach the walk's two kinds of holder-started clock, Slot flown empty if the holder keeps the permission by beginning an exercise it does not want, and Standstill with a term if it asks the rule-maker for a dated deferral, so the itinerary's hinge is reachable from a third party's clock by two doors, and stops that sit far apart on the walk, an act in the ground and a paper with the adversary's signature, are one choice apart in practice.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a distinct expiry, the condition lost, its carrier, and the last intervention, and the strange members (a closure that must precede its own notice, an option dated by its last witness rather than by the fact, a permission kept only by burning it, a reversal that expires at the new state's first ordinary act, a pause that hands the adversary the only clock the holder wrote) are kept as mechanisms and not softened into advice about deadlines.

next_crossfield_opening: Clocks created by keeping: connect Thawed to be ready, Kept on the machine, and Standstill with a term with walkaway-manufactures' Kettle on the hob, an alternative kept at a temperature at the price of a leak, and ask whether every upkeep that preserves an option also prices it to a counterparty, the renewal asked for, the pump bill seen, the thawed tray counted, so that the keeping is also the tell and an option kept long enough is an option the counterparty has already priced.

gaps: The type sentence's fence, 'without any party deciding about that option in particular', excluded the map's own Weekend closure and Pour the foundation, where a decree or an ordinance withdraws exactly the permission at issue for a class; the author's defence that the decree decides about the reserve and the exit dies as a side effect is false of a decree that forbids withdrawals by name. The fence the map practices in its boundary_case is the honest one: no party at the holder's own table decided, and a rule on a class from an authority not at the table is in. Written into the of clause, the boundary claims, and Weekend closure's closing sentence; Standstill with a term, the seed and the loop's and fork's landing, trimmed to the cases where the renewal belongs to a counterparty.
accepted: Weekend closure: the option is closed by an authority whose closure works only if it is not announced, since the announcement would be the signal to exercise, so the exit is shut in the hours the holder cannot act, as the Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address, the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 that was extended, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law, the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001, and the export-licence suspension or the delisting published after the fact; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to move what is yours; the carrier is the authority's calendar aligned to the hours the holder is shut out, the Friday night and the bank holiday; the last intervention that could have kept it is a transfer made on rumour, at the price of being wrong and of the discount the rumour market charges, since the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better; so this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, and a holder who waits for a date is waiting for a thing the mechanism forbids; adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable, the mechanism that chose the Friday; not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed is not one that must be a surprise, and not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which a party at the holder's own table decides, since the decree is an authority's rule on a class and nobody at the holder's table decided about the holder; the item is in on that fence and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect, since the decree forbids the exit by name.

Emergency over: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it expires when the parent does, whatever its own merits and with no date printed on it, as the emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing, the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it did read carried no date, and the holder must first find which parent paper carries it; the last intervention that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands, and the conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it; not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest, and not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven: the option expires by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in another hand, as amblyopia, which is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, the clubfoot cast in infancy, the second language spoken without an accent, which is contested as a hard window, the duckling that imprints in its first day; the condition lost is a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire; the carrier is the developmental timetable, and the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save; the last intervention that could have kept it is a screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child; adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case where the option's holder cannot be its own witness at all; not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Session ends: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no, as the bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that is dissolved, the permit application before a council that is re-elected, the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting, the offer approved by a committee that is disbanded in the reorganization; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor body starts it at zero; the condition lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; the carrier is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term; the last intervention that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, and the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no; adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote; not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Petition that goes stale: an option that requires many simultaneous yeses expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life, as the recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days, the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry, the crowd in the square that goes home, the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time; the condition lost is a coordination; the carrier is the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention; the last intervention that could have kept it is a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives; the recall and tender cases are observed and the crowd is analogy; adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by others' leaving; not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.

Slot flown empty: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose, as the airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived, the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them, the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use, the mining claim kept by annual labour, the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the regulator's usage ledger; the last intervention that could have kept it is the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody; adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule; not Pour the foundation, one act that vests, since here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, as the vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured, the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing, the drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent brought to room temperature, the opened surgical field, the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from; the condition lost is a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state; the carrier is a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation; the last intervention that could have kept it is not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings, so the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing; the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched, since here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed, and not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day, since here it falls on the good.

First or never: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date, and a holder who does nothing keeps it while a holder who does anything adjacent loses it, as the objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant that is waived if left out of the first response, the patent that is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the appeal waived by accepting the settlement, the election of remedies, the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used, the 'speak now' at the wedding; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written in a different place than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss; the last intervention that could have kept it is the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each of which costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists; not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.

Standstill with a term: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder, as the tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again, the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs, the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days, the furlough whose recall rights run six months, the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state; the carrier is the pause's own instrument, and its clock is the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote; the last intervention that could have kept it is the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted, since the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary; the statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it, and they are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock; adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.
limits: Options that become unattractive rather than unexercisable are out: the down round, the mine that can be dewatered at a price, the offer that got worse; and expiries in which a party at the holder's own table decided about this holder's option, the offer withdrawn, the exploding sheet, the rival's lock-up on every supplier, are carried by impasse-inventions, investor-tells, first-mover-forecloses, and walkaway-manufactures' Absent owner's clock. Weekend closure and Pour the foundation are in on that fence, since a decree or an ordinance is an authority's rule on a class and nobody at the holder's own table decided about the holder, and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect, since the decree forbids the exit by name; Weekend closure is unprobeable for the separate reason that its notice cannot precede it.
seed: The keeping is the tell. Standstill with a term says it outright (the counterparty 'now knows what the pause is worth to the holder'), Kept on the machine's pump bill is visible to anyone who can read a budget line, Thawed to be ready's tray is counted at closing, and Slot flown empty's empty flight is in the regulator's ledger by construction, so on the second half of the walk every upkeep that preserves an option also publishes its price to the party best placed to charge for it. The map points at this and does not contain it: a list of the ways an option's upkeep is legible to a counterparty, with the carrier of the legibility (the ledger, the bill, the renewal request, the discard count), whether the holder can keep the option without publishing it, and what the counterparty does with the reading. It connects to walkaway-manufactures' Kettle on the hob, where the kept alternative is read by the party keeping it warm, and it would explain why the last intervention on this map is so often 'ask before they learn it is needed'. The ledger's 'Read off the crowd' seed is the same thing from the other side, an expiry the holder can date only from others' exits, and both need a case with a carrier of its own before either is an item.
